description: This pie chart visually represents the distribution of two categories related to the performance or components of the Paper Copilot system, as described in the paper. The chart is divided into two distinct slices: a large orange slice labeled “Reduction” which constitutes 69.92% of the total, and a smaller blue slice labeled “Efficient deployment” which accounts for 30.08%. The “Reduction” slice is the dominant portion, and the “Efficient deployment” slice is visually emphasized by being slightly exploded or offset from the center of the pie. Both slices include their respective numerical values and percentages directly labeled within them. There is no legend present, and the two categories are clearly distinguished by their contrasting colors and labels. The chart appears to be arranged with the larger slice positioned at the bottom left and the smaller slice at the top right.
